name: HLK-PM03
title: HLK-PM series: 3 W potted AC-DC power modules, 3.3 V, 5 V, 9 V and 12 V outputs
summary: A family of four encapsulated mains-input converter modules, each rated 3 W, that turn 90 Vac to 245 Vac (85 Vac to 264 Vac, or 70 Vdc to 350 Vdc, in range) into one isolated DC output: 3.3 V at 1000 mA (HLK-PM03), 5 V at 600 mA (HLK-PM01), 9 V at 330 mA (HLK-PM09) or 12 V at 250 mA (HLK-PM12). All share one 34 mm × 20 mm × 15 mm four-pin through-hole body. The module runs with no external parts; a fuse and varistor in front of it, plus an X capacitor and common-mode choke where certification is wanted, make up the suggested input network. Outputs are protected against over-current and short circuit and recover on their own.
key_figures: 3.3 V, ≥1000 mA continuous, ≥1200 mA short time

notes: All four models share the 34 × 20 × 15 mm body and 3 W rating. The HLK-PM09 is a custom-order model.

Case marking on every model: INPUT: 100-240VAC 0.1A 50-60Hz, with OUTPUT: 3.3Vdc 1A (PM03), 5Vdc 0.6A (PM01), 9Vdc 0.33A (PM09) and 12Vdc 0.25A (PM12). The 12 V case is marked P/N: HLK-PM012; it should read HLK-PM12.

circuits.title: Typical application circuit
circuits.description: Mains enters on L and N. A fuse sits in series with the line; a varistor and an X capacitor C1 sit across the line pair after it, and a common-mode choke L1 carries both conductors to the module's two AC pins. On the isolated side an electrolytic C2 across +Vo and -Vo smooths the output that feeds the load RL.

parts.note: common-mode choke; windings 1-2 and 3-4, dotted ends 1 and 3

notes: The module's inputs are drawn as L and N; both module pins 1 and 2 are labelled AC.

operation.text: The module works on its own between mains and load; the suggested input and output parts add protection, certification compliance and lower ripple.
The input soft start lasts at most 50 ms. Inrush current is at most 10 A.
With no load the module draws under 0.1 W.

The 3.3 V and 5 V models limit at 150-200 % of maximum load, the 9 V and 12 V models at 110-150 %. A short on the output does not damage the module, and normal operation resumes by itself once the short is gone.

Full load is available from 110 V to 260 Vac (110 V to 350 Vdc). Below 110 V the permitted load falls toward 70 % at 70 V; above 260 Vac it falls to 80 % at 270 Vac, and above 350 Vdc to 80 % at 370 Vdc.
Full load is permitted from -25 °C to 60 °C ambient; above 60 °C the permitted load falls in a straight line to zero at 90 °C.

A slow-blow 0.5 A, 250 Vac fuse and a 10D561K varistor are the basic protection ahead of the module. A 0.1 µF, 275 Vac X capacitor and a 10-15 mH common-mode choke rated 70-500 mA are required for the assembly to pass certification; certification itself is done by the customer.
A 100-220 µF aluminium electrolytic across the output brings ripple from about 50 mV down below 30 mV.

The module is potted in plastic, rated to IP65 against moisture, vibration, water and dust. It is 100 % burned in and tested at full load, and its continuous working life is stated as over 100,000 hours. The quality guarantee period is one year.
Cooling is by natural convection. At room temperature internal parts rise at most 90 °C and the shell surface at most 60 °C.
